implementation: FCodeRescueCampaign::GetSurvivorArchetypeProfile maps every lesson family to a survivor title, icon, field need, rescue skill, dossier hook, and role color.
playability_result: Every city can spawn a distinct survivor roster identity without hand-authoring hundreds of per-city rows.

implementation: ASurvivorActor stores ArchetypeTitle, ArchetypeIconLabel, ArchetypeFieldNeed, ArchetypeRescueSkill, ArchetypeDossierHook, and ArchetypeAccentColor.
playability_result: The live survivor carries its own role identity for HUD prompts, rescue subtitles, helper markers, and future Blueprint/MetaHuman replacements.

implementation: Spawned survivor markers, halos, nameplates, and relief-camp boards use SurvivorArchetypeRosterRuntime, SurvivorRoleReadableNameplate, and SelectedLanguageSurvivorHandoff tags.
playability_result: The survivor area reads as a specific person/team with a role and rescue need, not a generic cyan objective cube.

implementation: UCodeRescueHUDWidget calls ASurvivorActor::GetInteractionPrompt and uses ArchetypeAccentColor for survivor hover state.
playability_result: The player sees the survivor role, lock reason, and rescue action before pressing E.

implementation: UCodeRescueObjectiveJournalWidget pulls the same campaign archetype profile into SURVIVOR INTEL DOSSIER role, need, rescue value, and dossier lines.
playability_result: Selected-language progress review keeps survivor identity readable before solve, after route open, after rescue, and after relaunch.

implementation: ASurvivorActor::Rescue includes archetype title, rescue skill, dossier hook, dispatch line, companion handoff, save update, and selected-language continuity.
playability_result: Rescue feedback connects the coding solve to a specific survivor role and preserves the language-run save loop.

implementation: ASurvivorActor adds SurvivorGestureReadabilityRuntime, SurvivorIdleLifePose, SurvivorLockedGesturePose, SurvivorRescueGesturePose, and delayed fade-out after rescue.
playability_result: Survivors show idle motion, locked refusal, and a rescue confirmation gesture before disappearing, without changing selected-language save behavior.
